# Historical Enel CP-2F pricing increment — frozen instructions

Run in this host session, one module at a time, using CP-OS. Public original PDF
bytes and text aids are pinned. Preflight/source selection happened before this
instruction lock; the same host has that context. This is not an isolated/blind
provider or independent context test. No agents, provider keys or paid calls.

Issuer Enel Finance International N.V.; guarantor/KPI perimeter Enel S.p.A.
and consolidated group as contractually defined. Target instrument only:
EUR1,000m initial0.000% notes, ISIN XS2066706818, due June17 2024. Do not copy
USD1,500m terms, other EUR/GBP tranches or TDG data. Historical knowledge cutoff
August3 2021: KPI observation June30 2021; target reference December31 2021.
Exclude subsequently observed year-end2021 outcomes, later ratings and today's
prices/conditions. Source3 is KPMG limited assurance, not reasonable assurance,
not a coupon/target-success certificate and not independent source verification
by this assistant. Retain its special-purpose/reliance limitation.

CP-0: admit the four original sources, their distinct entity/date/purpose,
selected coverage and limits. S1 contains the issuer's financial-note description
of issued terms; S2 is the2019 Euro-programme supplement, not the final terms;
S3 identifies the specific note and KPI definitions/performance; S4 attributes
the55% renewable-capacity target to the relevant2019 issues. Incomplete final
terms/base-prospectus package is a legal/schedule gap, not permission to fabricate
fields or call every blank zero. Read-only Poppler recovered S3 after pypdf's
missing AES dependency; preserve original bytes and this extraction history.

CP-2F (canonical CP-2E): actually consume the CP-0 answer. Apply the selected
broader CP-2F methodology, especially Steps4–6; retain all eight ESG registers
and the overall credit implication, with explicit source-limited/unassessed
fields elsewhere. This is a targeted positive sustainability-linked pricing
increment, not full Enel underwriting or a replacement for the separate TDG case.
No accepted CP-1 financial history is supplied: issuer-level materiality, coverage,
liquidity and whole capital-structure judgement are unavailable. Gate those
inferences; the source principal/coupon/ratchet still permit the local cost test.

Use6 transport headings Request/Sources/Findings/Calculations/Gaps/Next module.
Within Findings use T2G.1 through T2G.8 with descriptive titles. T2G.5 contains
separate Term and Condition tables; T2G.6 a Scenario table of conditional rates
and full-year coupon equivalents. Distinguish source facts, calculated values,
conditions, missing and known zero. Headline must explain the result and limits.

Independently compute from source inputs with Python:25bp=0.25 percentage point
=0.0025; initial0% versus conditional0.25%, annual principal-times-coupon values
and increment. Compare issue price99.123% and attributed effective yield0.189%
with the0% cash coupon; zero coupon does not mean zero funding cost. No invented
fee, actual accrued-payment schedule, day-count, exact first step date, outcome,
probability weighting, market spread benefit or automatic covenant default.

Check June's reported54,5% against55% separately from the ratio of source MW
lexemes46.580/85.535; preserve both and their rounding. The source locale uses
dot grouping/comma decimal; retain raw spellings. Do not infer target-date success
or failure from an interim observation, or apply generic group capacity when the
bond excludes certain post-issue acquisitions and nuclear energy. Performance,
external verification, publication and written notification are separate tests.
Keep one-time step direction/size and note the specific Final Terms are missing.
Equality at55% satisfies only the numerical limb, not the entire condition.

Translate to funding/monitoring without claiming the coupon-equivalent is net
hedged group cost, a spread forecast or proof of financing capacity. Explain the
credible contrary case of timely target/verification/notification satisfaction;
missing certificate is not an observed failure. Distinguish the programme's
no-automatic-default treatment from unreviewed other defaults. Name what would
change the view. Preserve all source locators and exact input/output hashes.

Compare actual model output with sources/instructions before release; repair only
observed faults and retain earlier attempts. Require a real subsequent analytical

S4 p.2’s approximate 15bp average benefit is issuer attribution, not this note’s greenium |

### T2G.7 — credit implication

The highest-priority supported driver is the conditional cash-interest ratchet: documentary 25bp upward repricing transmits to EUR2.5m additional annual coupon equivalent on full original principal. If the full condition fails, the first established financing effect is higher contractual cash interest in affected periods, reducing cash retained relative to timely satisfaction. No sourced operating break, liquidity shortfall, leverage deterioration, refinancing impairment, PD or LGD change can be established without financial inputs and schedule evidence.

The strongest contrary case is timely attainment of at least 55%, independently confirmed and properly published/notified: the coupon remains zero. June’s proximity to target permits neither a success forecast nor a failure forecast; missing later certificates are not observed breaches. Conviction is strong in the local arithmetic, bounded in documentary applicability/timing, and insufficient for issuer-wide materiality. No numeric confidence score is manufactured without its prescribed scoring facility.

At the historical cutoff, monitor December 31, 2021 performance and ensuing assurance, publication, appointment and notices; these were then prospective, not future events relative to the 2026 execution. Evidence of timely full satisfaction would defeat the step case; documented failure and applicable dates would establish affected cash flows. CP-6 debate handoff: the enforceable-looking conditional coupon channel is quantifiable locally, but its realized timing and whole-credit significance remain unproven.

| E: environmental | Issuer-specific emissions, climate, regulation, transition cost and liabilities | Missing transmission sizing | Broader environmental materiality unassessed | Obtain dated risk disclosures |
| S: social/governance | Labor/safety/liability/permit disclosures and separate conduct analysis | No supported event or ongoing exposure | No favorable/adverse social or governance finding | Obtain operating disclosures; refer conduct to governance module |
| M: market | Security-specific comparables, spread/mandate and refinancing evidence | Promotional averages cannot identify counterfactual cost | No spread forecast, greenium, access or security-selection conclusion | Obtain contemporaneous market evidence |
